tournament.name: Fuguete Champ 249 - Play Point P/ Top 10

decks.notes: The main theme of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Wild Growth, Utopia Sprawl, and Arbor Elf, allowing for early aggressive plays with creatures like Avenging Hunter and Nyxborn Hydra. Malevolent Rumble and Writhing Chrysalis provide removal and disruption options, while Evolution Witness and Eldrazi Repurposer offer versatility and resilience. Sagu Wildling and Boarding Party give additional aggression and reach, with Bannerhide Krushok and Jewel Thief adding further utility and power. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and spells, supported by strong mana ramp.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Balustrade Spy combo by milling your entire deck and then returning all creatures to the battlefield from the graveyard with Dread Return. The deck focuses on ramping up mana with defenders like Saruli Caretaker, Axebane Guardian, and Overgrown Battlement, while also using cards like Winding Way and Lead the Stampede to dig for combo pieces. The deck includes ways to recycle creatures with Generous Ent and Masked Vandal, as well as providing additional win conditions with creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Lotleth Giant.

The main focus of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Aggro-Burn deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Sneaky Snacker, as well as direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Temper. The deck also includes cards like Guttersnipe and Kessig Flamebreather to further increase the damage output. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient removal, ultimately burning them out before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to use aggressive Rakdos creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The creatures have abilities that either provide benefits when they enter the battlefield or when they attack, and the burn spells serve as additional direct damage to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes some lifegain cards to help stay alive and a few utility lands to ensure good mana fixing. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature damage and burn spells.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy with a blend of creature removal and card advantage. By utilizing efficient creatures like Krark-Clan Shaman and Nyxborn Hydra, along with spells like Cast Down and Eviscerator's Insight, it aims to quickly build a board presence while hindering the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Refurbished Familiar and Ichor Wellspring helps generate card advantage, while cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Twisted Landscape provide mana fixing. With a good balance of aggression and control elements, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This Jund Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures, removal spells, and graveyard disruption. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Krark-Clan Shaman and Nyxborn Hydra, along with removal spells such as Cast Down and Eviscerator's Insight. It also utilizes cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Cleansing Wildfire to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistent land drops and color fixing, allowing the aggressive strategy to be executed smoothly.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost creatures and use sacrifice effects to build up the Mortician Beetle and Bloodthrone Vampire. By continuously sacrificing creatures and generating value with cards like Village Rites and Supernatural Stamina, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and finish them off with Rite of Consumption. The deck's synergy between sacrificing creatures for benefits and applying pressure with aggressive creatures makes it a strong choice for aggressive Pauper 1 vs 1 play.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by a mix of burn spells and equipment. The key strategy is to build a board presence quickly and efficiently using low-cost creatures like Goblin Gaveleer and Goblin Tomb Raider, while also being able to deal direct damage with spells like Galvanic Blast. Additionally, the deck includes ways to boost the power of its creatures with cards like Mirran Banesplitter and Rally at the Hornburg, ensuring a relentless assault on the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using cards like Ephemerate to protect key creatures and spells, while also generating value through cards like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. It also includes a strong card draw engine with Deep Analysis and The Modern Age. The deck aims to outvalue opponent's threats and maintain board control until it can secure the win. The mana base is built to support the control strategy with Azorius Chancery and Ash Barrens providing consistency and flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy and generate value through sacrificing and recurring creatures. The deck aims to efficiently remove threats with removal spells like Cast Down and Nihil Spellbomb, while generating card advantage with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Grim Bauble. The deck also incorporates creatures that can put pressure on the opponent like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Pactdoll Terror. The deck's mana base includes various utility lands to support its strategy.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, allowing you to play aggressive creatures like Bannerhide Krushok and Nyxborn Hydra early on. Tamiyo's Safekeeping helps protect your creatures from removal spells, while board wipes can be answered with Cast into the Fire. Lead the Stampede helps refill your hand with additional creatures, ensuring a continuous stream of threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively infect the opponent with creatures like Glistener Elf and Ichorclaw Myr. This is achieved through pump spells like Might of Old Krosa and Mutagenic Growth to increase the damage output of these infect creatures. The deck also utilizes protection spells like Vines of Vastwood and Snakeskin Veil to protect the creatures from removal spells. The goal is to deal 10 points of infect damage to the opponent before they can stabilize or remove the threat.

The main focus of this Aggro Jund deck is to utilize sacrificing and recursion mechanics to continuously apply pressure on the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Refurbished Familiar and Nyxborn Hydra, and using spells like Fanatical Offering and Galvanic Blast, the deck can deal damage while also fueling its own card advantage. Additionally, cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Cleansing Wildfire provide additional flexibility and disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats and removal, while also maintaining a strong mana base with a mix of basic lands and artifact lands.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Kessig Flamebreather, while also utilizing burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to finish them off. The deck also includes cards like Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize to ensure card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to consistently apply pressure and use burn spells to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The focus of this mono blue aggro Pauper deck is to overwhelm the opponent with small, evasive creatures while controlling the board through counterspells and bounce spells. By using efficient creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Ninja of the Deep Hours, along with disruptive spells like Spellstutter Sprite and Counterspell, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while keeping the opponent off balance. The inclusion of card draw spells like Of One Mind helps to maintain card advantage, ensuring that the deck can maintain its aggressive tempo throughout the game.

The deck focuses on maximizing damage output by combining low-cost creatures with burn spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and lifegain to sustain the aggro strategy. The land base is designed to ensure a consistent mana curve and the ability to cast both red and black spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through fast and relentless aggression, utilizing a mix of creatures and direct damage spells to secure victory.
